journey.name: Server details and the face library
journey.description: The Settings tab reports on the server and leads to the face library.

actions.action: Clear the server URL field and type http://10.0.2.2:8971, type admin as the username and correct-horse as the password, then tap "Connect"
Verify that the Settings screen has a "Server" row describing the server as healthy
Verify that the Server page shows the server's version, 0.17.2-test (scroll down if needed)
Scroll to the recognition section and tap "Faces"
Verify that the face library lists the people "Alice" and "Bob"
Verify that the Settings screen is shown again
